description: Nancy "Nan" Roecker is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 12 in 2026, representing Calico Ridge, Henderson, Lake Las Vegas, and Sunrise Manor in Clark County. She is running to combat the affordability crisis, restore public safety, defend educational opportunity, and bring common-sense fiscal accountability to Nevada.
